summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an announcement to the market regarding a live investor event, 'Panorama Itaúsa 2026,' scheduled for October 6 at 10:00 a.m. Brasília time, at which CEO Milton Maluhy Filho will discuss the bank's strategy and perspectives. No securities transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory mechanics are disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report mapped to a US Form 8-K investor-communications item; there is no deal to arbitrage and no risk-arb angle.
